problem:
The basis $B$ of ${R}^{3}$ and the matrix $[\,T\,]_{B}$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{3}$ relative to $B$ are given by

$$
B={[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 8\end{aligned}]},\,[\,T\,]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & -4 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ a & b & c\end{aligned}].
$$

What is the value of $\,a+b+c,\,$ given that  

$$
T([\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}x-z \\ x+y \\ x-y-z\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
Let's denote the vectors of $B$ as ${{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}}.$ The $B$-matrix for $T$ is a matrix whose columns are the coordinates of the vectors $T({b}_{1}),$ $T({b}_{2}),$ and $T({b}_{3})$ relative to the basis $B.$

First, let's find the image of ${b}_{1},$ ${b}_{2},$ and ${b}_{3}$ under $T,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}T({b}_{1}) & =T([\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\ T({b}_{2}) & =T([\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\ T({b}_{3}) & =T([\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 8\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ 0 \\ -8\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

To find the coordinates of $T({b}_{1}),$ $T({b}_{2}),$ and $T({b}_{3})$ relative to the basis $B$, we consider the matrix

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}| & | & | & | & | & | \\ {b}_{1} & {b}_{2} & {b}_{3} & T({b}_{1}) & T({b}_{2}) & T({b}_{3}) \\ | & | & | & | & | & |\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we reduce the left-hand side to reduced row echelon form using Gaussian elimination. Then, on the right-hand side, we will obtain the $B$-matrix for $T:$

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 0 & -2 & 0 & -8 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 2 & 2 & 0 \\ 4 & 0 & 8 & -2 & -2 & -8\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{1}:=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -1 & 0 & -4 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 2 & 2 & 0 \\ 4 & 0 & 8 & -2 & -2 & -8\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-4{R}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -1 & 0 & -4 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 2 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 8 & 2 & -2 & 8\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{2}:=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2} \\ {R}_{3}:=\frac{1}{8}{R}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -1 & 0 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & \frac{1}{4} & -\frac{1}{4} & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
[\,T\,]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & -4 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ \frac{1}{4} & -\frac{1}{4} & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, $a=\frac{1}{4},$ $b=-\frac{1}{4},$ $c=1$ and 

$$
a+b+c=\frac{1}{4}+(-\frac{1}{4})+1=1.
$$
